added_comments.text: Dedupe on the event id (the webhook idempotency key), so redelivered events are dropped no matter how far apart they arrive, and distinct events are never merged.
one from the notification subscriber, one from the audit log

rationale: The agent replaced the time-window heuristic (DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS/lastSeen map) with dedup keyed on the webhook's actual idempotency key, which correctly handles redeliveries at any interval instead of just tuning a window; it also removed a duplicate subscriber registration in subscribers.ts, eliminating a second underlying source of duplicate delivery. Both changes address root causes rather than adding a special case to the old workaround, and the payment.failed opt-out override logic is untouched.
